item.title: Rome Police seeking information on fatal pedestrian accident
item.description: Rome Police are looking for the driver of a car that was involved in an accident earlier this month in which one person is now dead.

item.title: Home care workers, lawmakers want transparency on $11B CDPAP operator PPL
item.description: New York lawmakers and advocates are pushing for transparency from Public Partnerships LLC, the company running the state's Medicaid home care system, after 150,000 workers and 90,000 patients left the program due to missing paychecks and benefits.

item.title: Mayor's Budget clears E&A, Common Council next
item.description: Utica Mayor Mike Galime's budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year was approved by the city's Board of Estimate and Apportionment in a meeting on Thursday.

item.title: Fire prison chief and fix clemency, advocates tell Hochul
item.description: Criminal justice advocates rallied at the state Capitol, accusing Governor Kathy Hochul of hypocrisy for demanding federal accountability while ignoring deaths in New York state prisons, and urging her to fire the corrections commissioner and fix the broken clemency process.
